charts.title: WASP-80 b: orbits around WASP-80
charts.description: The orbits of WASP-80's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-80 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kokori et al. 2023 (2023ApJS..265....4K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KOKORI_ET_AL__2023): P 3.06785251 d

charts.title: WASP-80 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-80 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (54) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 243921117, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 9-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
